title: RecordStore keeps its own copy of the cloud account (cloudAccount) and of the pending-marker target (marksPending), pushed by CloudSync, rather than reading them from CloudConnection
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore.swift:47-50 marksPending, cloudAccount, cloudName (@ObservationIgnored); CloudSync.linkStore sets them after every transition and after a keep (ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/CloudSync.swift). The account is read from sync-account on each send. Found while building S3 PR 1 (US-25 AC11m); cloudName feeds Apple Health's erase gate (US-72 AC10)
